whyHead: Why schools, councils and homeowners use Secura
whyText: Owner Peter Jagminas has been fabricating since 2000, and today a team of 11 handles manufacturing, powder coating and installation in-house.
faq: Right across Adelaide. We're based in Hackham in the southern suburbs.
The Department of Education (schools and kindergartens), local councils, industrial and commercial sites, retirement villages and homeowners.
Yes. We're a fully certified and licensed fencing contractor, licence number BLD 245296.
Monday to Friday, 8am to 3:30pm. Closed weekends. Quotes are free.
aboutSub: Family-run fencing and fabrication, Hackham SA.
aboutParas: Peter Jagminas started out on his own as a steel fabricator, estimator and installer, trading as Freebird Fabrications from 2000. Secura Fence & Fabrication began in 2011.
Today it's a family business run by a husband and wife team, with 11 employees. Manufacturing, supply, installation and powder coating are all done in-house in Hackham.
Clients include the Department of Education, local councils, industrial and commercial sites, retirement villages and homeowners right across Adelaide.
